valueProp: The Pharma Coach is a medical-sales career coaching practice that helps nurses, healthcare professionals and experienced sales reps position their existing experience for pharmaceutical and medical-device sales roles.

services.name: Discovery call
services.body: A 45-minute call with Jebb to review your background and the roles you are targeting. You leave with a read on your fit and a specific next step, before you commit to a program.

services.name: Fast Track Academy
services.body: A self-paced path for turning your current experience into a pharmaceutical-sales job search. Covers how hiring managers read a resume, how to target roles, and how to prepare for the interview.

services.name: Mastermind Accelerator
services.body: Weekly strategy, mentorship and accountability while you actively pursue roles. Built for candidates who want live feedback on applications and interviews as they happen.

services.name: VIP Signature Access
services.body: A customized career strategy with direct, high-touch mentorship from Jebb. For candidates who want the plan built around their specific background and timeline.

differentiators.name: Coaching from the person who does the hiring
differentiators.body: Jebb has spent more than 10 years interviewing and hiring medical sales reps. The feedback on your resume and interview answers comes from the side of the table that makes the decision.

differentiators.name: A carried bag, not just a classroom
differentiators.body: Jebb has sold in the field since 2001 and holds 19 President's Club awards. The advice is drawn from territory work and quota, not from general career theory.

differentiators.name: Built for career changers, not beginners
differentiators.body: The work starts from the experience you already have, clinical or commercial, and translates it into the language a pharmaceutical hiring manager recognises. You are not treated as though you are starting from zero.

differentiators.name: Three entry points rather than one package
differentiators.body: A $25 discovery call, a $899 self-paced academy, a $2,499 accelerator and $5,799 high-touch mentorship. You can start at the level that matches your timeline and budget instead of buying one fixed programme.

differentiators.name: No placement or earnings guarantee
differentiators.body: Hiring and compensation depend on employers, your experience and your execution. Results reported across past clients are shared as reported figures, not as promises about your outcome.

icp: Registered nurses and other clinical professionals, including PTs, OTs, chiropractors and medical assistants, moving from patient care into a commercial role.
Healthcare technicians such as surgical, laboratory and pharmacy techs using clinical familiarity as a route into medical sales.
Sales professionals from B2B, B2C, retail and inside sales repositioning their selling experience for consultative healthcare selling.
Current pharmaceutical and medical-device representatives pursuing promotion, a stronger territory or higher commission.

how.name: Start with the discovery call
how.body: A 45-minute paid call with Jebb. You talk through your background, the roles you are aiming at, and whether coaching makes sense before any programme is discussed.

how.name: Work directly with Jebb
how.body: Coaching is delivered by Jebb himself rather than handed to an account team. Programme pages set out what is included at each level.

how.name: Focus on three things
how.body: Positioning your resume for the roles you want, building the relationships that put a name to your application, and preparing for the interview before you have one.

how.name: Confirm terms before you enrol
how.body: Current inclusions, pricing and terms are listed on each official programme page. Review them before paying.
